AI Language Tutor

A patient tutor who never gets tired of the same question. Practise real conversations, get your mistakes explained and build vocabulary around your own life, at your own level.

TL;DR
  • Best for conversation practice, corrections and vocabulary for real situations.
  • Tell it your level, your goal and the situations you'll use the language in.
  • Ask it to correct you after each message, with a short explanation.

What this coach helps with

  • Daily conversation practice
  • Correcting your writing with explanations
  • Vocabulary for work, travel or exams
  • Preparing for a job interview in another language
  • Understanding grammar with simple examples

Prompts you can copy

Copy a prompt, paste it into the Zehn AI Chat or any AI assistant, and replace the parts in [brackets] with your own details.

  1. Be my [language] tutor. My level is [beginner/intermediate/advanced]. Chat with me about [topic] and correct my mistakes after each message.

  2. Role-play a [situation, e.g. ordering at a café] in [language]. Keep your sentences short and wait for my reply.

  3. Correct this text and explain each mistake in one simple sentence: [text].

  4. Teach me 10 words I need for [situation] in [language], each with an example sentence.

  5. Explain [grammar point] with three examples from everyday life, then give me five practice sentences.

  6. I have a job interview in [language] for [role]. Ask me typical questions and help me improve my answers.

  7. Quiz me on these words, one at a time, and repeat the ones I get wrong: [words].

  8. Rewrite my sentence so it sounds natural to a native speaker, and tell me why: [sentence].

  9. Make a 15-minute daily study plan for reaching [goal] in [language] in [months].

  10. Tell me a very short story in [language] at my level, then ask me three questions about it.

  11. What are the five most common mistakes [native language] speakers make in [language]? Give an example of each.

  12. Speak only [language] with me for the next 10 messages. If I'm stuck, give me a hint, not the answer.

Two example conversations

Written by the Intellect AI team to show the style of answers. Not a real user conversation.

ExamplePractising English at a café

YouCan I have one coffee and how much is cost?

Language TutorGreat start! A more natural way: “Could I have a coffee, please? How much is it?” In English we say “a coffee”, and “how much is it” without “cost”. Now I'm the barista: “Sure! Would you like it with milk?”

ExampleLearning work vocabulary

YouI start a job in a hotel in Dubai next month. I need English for the reception desk.

Language TutorLet's start with five phrases you'll use every day: “Do you have a reservation?”, “May I see your passport, please?”, “Your room is on the fourth floor.”, “Breakfast is served from 7 to 10.”, “Is there anything else I can help with?” Now I'm a guest arriving late at night. Greet me.

Tips for better answers

  • Tell it your native language, so it can explain mistakes that people like you usually make.
  • Ask for corrections at the end of each message instead of interrupting the flow.
  • Practise the situations you'll really face, not textbook topics.
  • Ten minutes every day beats an hour once a week.

Questions people ask

Can I learn a language with an AI tutor?

An AI tutor is excellent for practice: conversation, corrections, vocabulary and explanations at your level, any time of day. It works best alongside listening to real speakers and, if possible, talking to people. Use it daily for short sessions and ask it to correct every message so mistakes don't become habits.

Which languages can the AI language tutor teach?

Modern AI models handle most widely spoken languages well, including English, Arabic, Russian, Hindi, Urdu, French and Spanish. Quality can be lower for rare languages and dialects. Tell the tutor which variety you need, for example Gulf Arabic or British English, so it uses the right words and spellings.

How do I practise speaking, not just writing?

Read your replies out loud before you send them, and repeat the tutor's corrected sentences aloud two or three times. If the chat app has a microphone button, you can dictate your answers to practise pronunciation and fluency. Role-play situations you'll actually face, like interviews or shopping.

What level should I tell the AI tutor I am?

Describe what you can do instead of guessing a label: “I can introduce myself but can't follow films” is more useful than “intermediate”. Ask the tutor to test you with a few questions and set the level itself. If replies feel too hard or too easy, tell it to adjust.
